added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest carries empty baseline_suite and after_suite fields and names no gate-log pair, so the added-failure count was not derived from the reviewed run's own arms

findings.text: follow-on: the census-completeness guarantee rests on a run-scratch checker (check_patch_census.py under the run directory) that no landed test invokes, so a later edit dropping patch sites would pass the suite unnoticed; a landed assertion over the fragment would make the guarantee durable.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; 7d06af35 adds the eight mp.setattr rows (_observed_phase 64 and 83, _worker_record_liveness 71/74/77, _carries_orientation_write 80, _ledger_run_id_reader 86, FLEET_BLOCKED_STATES 89) in tests/test_a_live_run_never_reads_dead.py, reorders existing rows with no row lost, and adds a receiver-wide setattr search command and a census_method note.
item_verdicts.done_when: the delta's measure is census completeness; the run's check_patch_census.py reports RECORDED=98 MISSING=0 at 7d06af35 (repair-head.log) and RECORDED=90 MISSING=8 at 60eafa7e (repair-negative-control.log).
item_verdicts.goal: commit 7d06af35 completes the recovery map's patch census at docs/evidence/fragments/every-module-fits-a-worker-window/recovery-split-map.json; the census now records 47 patched names across 8 more sites, and an independent AST scan of tests/ finds 98 static setattr sites and records every one.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports the census repaired to 47 patched names and 103 sites including all 98 static recovery setattr sites, with placement 353/353 and no cycle (map-check.log EXIT=0), and empty baseline_suite and after_suite fields because the node ran no pytest arm.
item_verdicts.write_paths: commit 7d06af35 changes only docs/evidence/fragments/every-module-fits-a-worker-window/recovery-split-map.json and .html, both inside the map node's two declared fragment write paths.

justifications.durability: the census guard is real and fires, since deleting the repair reddens it (repair-negative-control.log EXIT=1), but it lives only in the run directory and no landed test reads the map fragment, so a later edit that drops sites would leave the suite green.
justifications.evidence: the gate check_patch_census.py asserts the census against a positive control of 98 sites and reddens at the parent (repair-negative-control.log EXIT=1, 8 missing) while passing at head (repair-head.log EXIT=0), so it measures the artifact rather than claiming it.
justifications.fit: the added rows use the census's existing {file,line,kind} shape and sit in the modules and repoint tables of recovery-split-map.html, and no added name carries a part number, a version or the word core.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the delta closes the census gap the prior review named; my independent AST scan over tests/ finds 98 static setattr sites and every one is recorded at docs/evidence/fragments/every-module-fits-a-worker-window/recovery-split-map.json, where the parent map at 60eafa7e missed eight.
justifications.reuse: the delta is docs-only and adds no production mechanism, so it forks no capability the repository owns; the run-scratch checker duplicates no landed guard because none exists.
justifications.scope_discipline: commit 7d06af35 touches only docs/evidence/fragments/every-module-fits-a-worker-window/recovery-split-map.json and .html, both declared write paths, editing no source or test file.
